'''Zaalbar's bowcaster''' was one of [[Zaalbar]]'s only personal possessions. Over many years of [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]], he made many modifications but it conformed greatly to the traditions of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] village of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. When Zaalbar was captured by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], his [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] was confiscated but later retrieved after he had sworn a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ZaalbarBowcasterIcon.png|thumb|left|64px|In-Game Icon]]
Zaalbar's bowcaster first appeared in the [[2003]]<ref name="Anniversary">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref> [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]].'' The player was not required to keep it once obtained, and it could be sold at any vendor, or simply placed in any container.<ref name="KOTOR" />
